title: Tofu and vegetable red curry
summary: Tofu and vegetable red curry is a thai dinner built around firm tofu and vegan Thai red curry paste, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Tofu and vegetable red curry. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add firm tofu and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and vegan Thai red curry paste.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until light coconut milk is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Tofu and vegetable red curry before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Tofu and vegetable red curry.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
